title: Ryuki Secret Provider Runtime Binding
description: Closed, value-free expected binding for one retained production secret-provider runtime. The raw document digest is a leaf input to the provider payload and runtime witness; this document never carries provider-payload, runtime-inventory, deployment-profile, registry, guard, receipt, closure, workload-response, or self digests.

capability_bindings.description: Exact nonempty capability-semantic inventory. Runtime semantic validation additionally requires strict bytewise ordering and uniqueness by capability_id.

retained_consumer_ids.description: Exact nonempty inventory of authority-bearing consumers retaining this runtime. Runtime semantic validation additionally requires strict bytewise ordering.

binding_digest.description: Independently recomputed SHA-256 of the ryuki-canonical-json-v1 leaf projection containing this profile id/version, API flavor and protocol, and exact semantic capabilities and limitations. The projection excludes this binding document's raw digest, provider payload/runtime/inventory digests, registries, deployment profiles, guards, receipts, closures, workload responses, and secret or token identifiers.

endpoint_base_url_binding_digest.description: SHA-256 of the ryuki-secret-provider-endpoint-base-url-binding-v1 canonical leaf projection over normalized HTTPS scheme, host, effective port, and normalized reverse-proxy path prefix. Runtime canonicalization rejects userinfo, query, and fragment before independently recomputing this digest.

ca_trust_binding_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact retained, provider-specific CA trust bytes under ryuki-secret-provider-ca-trust-binding-v1; no built-in root set or caller-supplied digest can satisfy this measurement.

connect_timeout_millis.description: Exact retained adapter hard cap, not an independent policy maximum; runtime admission must also reconcile it with the selected SecurityLimitProfile.

request_timeout_millis.description: Exact retained adapter hard cap, not an independent policy maximum; runtime admission must also reconcile it with the selected SecurityLimitProfile.

response_body_max_bytes.description: Exact retained adapter hard cap, not an independent policy maximum; runtime admission must also reconcile it with the selected SecurityLimitProfile.

identity_binding_digest.description: SHA-256 of the ryuki-secret-provider-workload-identity-binding-v1 canonical leaf projection over the exact expected Kubernetes namespace and service-account name; excludes UIDs, tokens, and token identifiers.

audience_binding_digest.description: SHA-256 of the ryuki-secret-provider-workload-audience-binding-v1 canonical leaf projection over the exact singleton expected audience.

token_path_binding_digest.description: SHA-256 of the ryuki-secret-provider-token-path-binding-v1 canonical leaf projection over the normalized absolute projected-token path. The projection never contains token bytes.

provider_authentication_binding_digest.description: Independently recomputed SHA-256 of the named canonical leaf projection over authentication kind, normalized Vault namespace/auth mount/role, expected policy, token type, renewability, and TTL-limit ids. It excludes tokens, accessors, leases, JWT ids, this binding document's raw digest, provider payload/runtime/inventory digests, registries, deployment profiles, guards, receipts, closures, and workload responses.
